order: 본 실험 판단 비교·절제 덧붙임 2 — 패치 단위 채점 (11/17 밤 초안, 사용자가 붙여 넣어 전달)

inputs.point_scores: PH/main_judgeabl_v1/PHD-MAIN-JUDGEABL-v1/okbits_<prior>.npz (per-variant point target-ok, a1 rule; rows = keep = paired GT points of the four cases)
inputs.patch_judgments: variants/<region>__<prior>.npz (region per variant, patch_id) mapped to JC gid order through geometry_raw patch_id; 기존 4 three-region row uses its own point regions (JUDGEAPPLY patches) and is reported at point level and patch level on JUDGEAPPLY patches via truth/exp current_patch_id
inputs.gt: JC analysis/gt_<prior>.npz (paired, gid, case 0..4 incl. 3 = outside four, place, target_distance_v, target_ok_v); JC analysis/patches_<prior>.npz majority_counts (cases 0..4)
inputs.patch: JP patch_<prior>.npz (area, kind, place, building, centre)

definitions.patch_case: JC oracle rule on majority_counts (cases 0..4 incl. 3 = outside four): single largest count -> that case; a tie that includes case 0 among the largest -> case 0; any other tie -> '동률' (excluded and counted). Patches whose case is 3 -> '네 경우 밖' (counted separately)
definitions.min_points: patches with fewer than 3 GT points (all cases incl. outside four) are excluded and counted
definitions.patch_target_ok: among the patch's GT points whose case equals the patch case, the share with target-ok (main a1 point rule) >= 0.5
definitions.patch_name_ok: patch judgment == expected judgment of the patch case (0->일치, 1->영상 깊이 사용, 2->사전정보 사용, 4->결측; JC current definition)
definitions.weights: patch areas differ (JC geometry_raw area) -> shares are area-weighted; patch counts reported alongside
definitions.mixed_bins: share of the majority case among the patch's GT points (all five cases): 100 %, [80, 100), [50, 80), < 50 %; by patch case and JC place
definitions.point_level_check: point target-ok from okbits must equal tables/s_main_summary (and s_all_variants) for every variant x case

gap_split.wrong_point: point target not ok under the variant
gap_split.a_mixing: point case != patch case (patches excluded by the 3-point rule or ties counted in their own row)
gap_split.b_data_limit: point case == patch case and the matching-data target is also outside tau at that point; matching data: case 1 (prior error) -> image only; case 2 (image error) -> prior only; case 4 (image missing) -> prior only; case 0 (both valid) -> both prior only and image only outside tau
gap_split.c_judgment: point case == patch case and the matching-data target is inside tau but the variant's target is outside
gap_split.b_distance: for (b) cells: |distance to the matching-data target| median and 90 % (case 0: the smaller of the two)
gap_split.splits: case x JC point place (면 안쪽, 면 경계, 건물 가장자리)

figures.P1: per prior four mixed patches (majority share < 80 %): ALS = patch case 사전정보 오류, place 건물 가장자리 two and 면 안쪽 two; LoD2 = patch case 영상 깊이 오류 (the order's other highlighted cell), same split; within each, largest GT point count first, one per building; panel: oblique training image crop with the patch, section ±0.15 m slab along tangent1 x normal (GT points coloured by case, prior plane, MVS points, method target, patch edges at ±0.125 m)
figures.P2: per prior, per case: patch-unit vs point-unit target-ok for every variant (dot plot)
